`interface ITextConverter`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.converter` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ITextConverter.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/converter/ITextConverter.java)

Turns a value of a type of yours into the string that a text shows.

## Description

Register one with [`TextConverter.register`](/reference/text/textconverter/#TextConverter-method-register): every text, tooltip and text setter that takes an `Object` goes through it.

- [Text markup and effects](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/text-markup-and-effects/)

## Method details

<a id="ITextConverter-method-supports"></a>

### supports

`boolean supports(Object text)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

If `true`, this converter turns `text` into a string; JOID asks the converters from the last registered to the first and uses the first that answers `true`.

<a id="ITextConverter-method-convert"></a>

### convert

`String convert(Object text)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Returns the string that a text shows for `text`; JOID calls it only when `supports` returned `true`.
